pure-announcement.rationale: A how-to reference for building and hosting plugin marketplaces, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: Agent Skills format covers a component plugins can carry, not the marketplace catalog and distribution mechanism documented here; no nearest concept overlaps substantively.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Schema fields and behaviors are verifiable against the shipped validator and CLI.

durability.rationale: The marketplace.json schema, six source types and their behaviors are pinned to specific releases (v2.1.193/.224/.229/.239 caveats) and will churn; the genuinely durable bits (SHA-pinned sources, append-only rename history, explicit user acceptance of command sources) are buried product mechanics.

actionability.rationale: Every step is a Claude Code config field or CLI invocation — highly actionable inside the product, transferring little to anyone building or deciding elsewhere.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles schema reference, source types, hosting and auth, container seeding, managed restrictions and troubleshooting — many separable product details, none of which stands alone as a concept.
